title: Tooth device demonstration at the Pentagon

tellings.quote: We gave a demonstration at the Pentagon. We fitted this device to this general,

plain: Sometime in the 1960s, a device fitted into a tooth was demonstrated on a general at the Pentagon, the headquarters of the US military. The researcher Andrija Puharich says he gave that demonstration himself: "We fitted this device to this general." If true, it would mean the top of the military took a direct interest in his inventions.
